_comment: P00-003 capability reality matrix. Levels: implemented/unit_tested/fixture_e2e/real_e2e/ui_connected are booleans or 'partial'; production_ready is false unless the capability works for a real user end-to-end without developer intervention.

Requirement.notes: rule/lexicon parser only; out-of-lexicon concepts fail (P01 will add LLM planner with rule fallback)

Search.notes: 8 providers real-parallel in golden; browser search worker absent (Phase 15); query planning hardcoded lexicon

Provider.notes: 84 registered; 20 adapters; 16 search-verified; only 4 anonymous-download-verified; matrix UI missing (Phase 8)

Browser.notes: real headed Chromium, locator chain, pause/takeover/return verified; BUT create-session API schema broken (P00-004), UI is 2.5s screenshot polling, no cursor/typing visibility (Phase 2)

Auth.notes: login executor works against local fixture site only; no provider recipes; session is placeholder string, not storage_state (Phase 3)

Registration.notes: result classification verified on fixture; no API endpoint, no provider recipes (Phase 5)

Session.notes: current persisted session is a placeholder string 'fixture-session:...'; real storage_state persistence/restoration/validity probing required (Phase 3)

Download.notes: gating/streaming/checksum/sniff/safe-extract verified incl. 112MB; gaps: adapters read small files fully into memory (P06-005), no HTTP resume, no 1GB test (Phase 7)

Parser.notes: 16+ formats verified incl. real WB zip bundles; preview only virtualized by row cap

Build.notes: pipeline+checkpoints+validation+package verified; BUT UI hardcodes artifacts.slice(0,2), keys default country/year, aggregation defaults mean — Build Planner + plan editor required (Phase 17-19)

Provenance.notes: source/transform/field lineage verified in golden; viewer is basic; build-plan snapshot + agent decision snapshot missing (Phase 22)

UI.notes: three-column workspace works (screenshot evidence) but: browser session create broken, no account center, no build plan editor, no project/task model (Phase 24)
